dimensions.mission: Read existing cross-product research intent metadata unchanged.
dimensions.flexibility_and_history: Expand readers; preserve exact published IDs/bytes, UUID generation, retries and negative identity reservations.
dimensions.context_efficiency: One shared synthetic fixture and saved-byte vertical, no broad scientific suite.
dimensions.research_truth: URI and opaque ID acceptance do not admit source evidence; UNKNOWN retained.
dimensions.owner_operability: No migration; same prepared bytes/IDs; both reader versions must be accepted.
dimensions.execution_to_cashflow: Engineering reliability only; no alpha/trading claim.
dimensions.monitoring_and_recovery: No scheduler/reminders; code revert preserves data history.
dimensions.build_vs_buy: Existing JSON Schema, Git and stdlib only.
dimensions.security: Opaque URI never dereferenced; physical/unsafe URI refused; private Scout bodies excluded from public evidence.
dimensions.red_team: Actual records exposed fixture blindspots; independent review caught and closed legacy-percent regression.

capability_radar.watch: New measured cross-product mismatch after accepted versions.

recovery: Ordinary code revert; preserve all published IDs/revisions and native evidence. An older reader can report typed invalid; do not rewrite data to hide it.
